definition_identity.algorithm: definition_digest is sha256: followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex of the existing strict canonicalJson UTF-8 encoding of this complete installed public module value. No self-digest field is embedded in the module.
definition_identity.scope: This digest identifies the complete public module value only. Independent roots and reachable type/value dependencies are additionally bound by original full source identity, projection identity, generated closure and installed product identity; a module digest does not cover those external values.

scope.supported: Node public unprotected 0.6 members supplied as actual owned bytes. Genuine whole native admission only; independent member IRs retained, singleton selection, isolated_read.
scope.existing: Existing top-level type definitions, the legacy package_set_node subtree and its APIs remain unchanged. Fresh-path and retained-read identities/policies remain distinct.

api.javascript_boundary: NativePackageSetInput06/member bytes/provider configs are in-process nonwire records. Capture closed own data records/arrays and genuine opaque references separately; never JSON-copy opaque handles or execute getters to inspect them. Functions accept unknown at runtime and reject invalid/foreign brands despite narrow declarations.
api.declaration_installation: All existing opaque types import their unique symbols from their original installed owner, never regenerate brands in packageset06/types. New four opaque brands are defined only once in Core packageset06/types; Read imports them and uses private same-instance Core registry. Actual import sources must export each symbol in installed CJS/ESM/CTS/MTS; template text alone is not compile proof.
unit_order: Core seven APIs plus shared carriers and registry.
Read five APIs including actual delivery token+handoff in a second coherent unit after Core membership; no partial public fake token.
api.private_binding: Read can register actual operation+delivered result with a private same-instance Core bridge. No public delivered mint or registration export; serialized views, tokens from old Core/Read, foreign instances and arbitrary ready objects never acquire brand.

input.ownership: Before any callback or first await validate limits and both array counts, pure-copy set/tuple/operation, capture all genuine admitted whole requests/byte-authority identities, and own every member Uint8Array slice synchronously using exact current a19_owned_byte_whole input wrapper rules. No subclass/proxy/symbol/enumerable-extra relaxation; permitted nonenumerable decorations are ignored without invoking hooks.
input.count_order: Count declared and source arrays independently before allocating/copying members. Positive caller limits <=10000 and <=104857600 are permitted. Do not deduplicate either input to fit a limit or erase duplicate-decision evidence. Use safe subtraction/checked sum of intrinsic visible byteLength before copy; per-member physical25MiB also remains.
input.immutable: Subsequent caller mutations/detachment of original buffers/arrays/record fields or provider config cannot change this captured operation. Two real owned copy layers exist: the outer PackageSet synchronously owns ALL sources before callbacks, and each sequential admitSectionBytesNode independently copies that owned slice again under unchanged owned-byte admission rules. Both buffers can be live concurrently; decode/canonical temporaries may also exist. Count each supplied original visible source length once for the 100MiB source limit, never call that sum a heap/peak-memory ceiling or promise no extra copies. After each awaited owned-byte admission settles, release that member outer raw strong reference; after any failure or final return release all remaining outer raw references in finally. Owned-byte admission internal copy lifetime and release remain its original rules. Retained admission stores genuine whole tokens/metadata, not raw PackageSet source buffers; no secure-erasure claim or mutation of caller bytes. No asset-source file reads or fabricated path/FD/mtime. Dependency/module loads are separate actual I/O.
input.metadata: PackageSet structure is original PackageSet exact member_id/asset_id/asset_version/A and Selection. Structure validation is claims_not_authenticated. Never infer expected A from mutable source or change declarations to match output.
input.tuple: In-process input tuple is native CandidateVersionTuple06. Capture complete closed ten-string tuple before R07 version classification rather than misclassifying a well-shaped old/mixed tuple as generic shape invalid. Explicit old/UnsupportedVersionTuple gives READ_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION; other nonnative tuple with native coordinate gives READ_MIXED_VERSION_TUPLE, otherwise READ_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. Exact native match is required for admission.
input.resource_limits: Preserve per-container physical25MiB/decoded12MiB/member8MiB/128 entries; 100MiB sums physical member-source byte lengths, not decoded totals, arrays, IR size or heap usage. No arbitrary aggregate decoded8 or changed primitive guard.

authority.provider: TrustedNativePackageSetMemberProvider06 is minted from closed {host_id,host_epoch,observe} with synchronous callback. Snapshot config; no plain/frozen JSON substitute. Callback exception is provider_failed; thenable or malformed return is provider_observation_invalid and must not be awaited.
authority.request: Membership observation receives frozen set_id/members/selection/operation/phase, with phase initial for initial call and read for both explicit recheck phases.
authority.rows: Preserve original exact full member_id/asset_id/asset_version/A allow match. No undeclared row, duplicate full identity row, accessor/proxy/extra key/symbol or invalid scalar. Missing rows and deny rows are absent grants. issued_at<=current_ms<expires_at, equality expired. Every row pins configured host_id/host_epoch. Provider current_ms must not decrease across accepted rows/calls. Wrong binding/expiry/rollback is provider_observation_invalid; valid deny yields SET_MEMBER_UNAUTHORIZED at R07 stage.
authority.byte_grant: Each member carries its independently genuine admitted SectionReadRequest06 in whole_asset mode and NativeSectionByteReadAuthority06. Owned-byte admission metadata observation, signature policy and grant run once per supplied member; no implicit true callback, no inferred byte permission from a membership row. All initial members are owned before any of these callbacks.
authority.lifetime: Membership provider is retained privately by admitted set and reused for explicit rechecks. A prior successful observation is not an infinite lease. New Read uses independent genuine retained-read authority and Host observations; Read never implies action/output permission. Original synchronous member clock monotonic rule remains separate from retained-read Host time rules.

steps: Pure input/brand/count/ownership capture; no callbacks on local input failure.
Sequential genuine owned-byte whole admission in original source-array order, preserving every actual success or failure and its diagnostics; do not expose partial admitted set.
Apply original R07 precedence over source presence and actual results: unauthorized, missing, extra, duplicate, version, actual member validity, unsupported merge, selection not found/ambiguous.
Mint opaque native admission only if all member sources have genuine verified whole snapshots and exact asset/version/A, tuple and selection checks pass.
admission.failure_mapping: At member-validity position, first actual member failure in source order is returned verbatim as member_failure with local_failure=member_admission_failed, decision=null. This preserves owned-byte admission authorization/capability/integrity/input stages and never calls permission denial an invalid asset. An accepted whole whose actual asset/version/A contradicts declared member returns READ_CORE_INVALID without altering actual digest. Earlier R07 presence/authorization/duplicate/version failures retain priority and member_failure=null. Unexpected internal exception is core_unavailable, never fabricated READ_CORE_INVALID.
admission.brand: Whole snapshots come only from same-instance admitSectionBytesNode, never inspect JSON or serialized brands. Inspect view exposes original tokens and readonly values; no new snapshot issuance, no modified original verification/request/integrity history. Whole verification status, actual A/C/E0.3 and complete IR remain those actually observed by owned-byte admission.
admission.selection: Resolve exactly one matching asset_id+asset_version+judgment_id across all admitted catalog rows. Different member IDs containing same selected logical identity produce READ_SELECTION_AMBIGUOUS; no arbitrary first match. Selection stays singleton; do not resolve required external context from other set members.
admission.recheck: Explicit recheck(admission, read|handoff) requires genuine admission, fresh original member observation with phase=read and original R07 rules over immutable admitted members. No reparse/new byte grant/asset read, no new IR/E. Fake admission gives invalid_read_request; bad phase gives invalid_read_request.

read.entry: readNativePackageSet accepts an already admitted native PackageSet and genuine retained-read admitted request+authority. No raw-member overload, duplicate decode or changed selection. Request must be exact_selection, normalized judgment_ids exactly one equal set.selection, same asset/version/native tuple and handle=null. A larger selection/other mode is invalid_read_request before authority/Host/sink. signal if supplied must be genuine AbortSignal; preaborted yields cancelled with zero callbacks.
read.permission_sequence: Validate all brands and fixed provider identity first; fresh membership recheck before retained-read preparation. prepareRetainedSectionRead selected original whole with actual requested retained authority/policy. Recheck membership after this awaited authorization and before Host creation. Denied prepare returns exact preparation_failure, local_failure=read_preparation_failed; no Host/sink.
read.host: Use same-instance original retained-read trusted Host/private lifecycle. Pin configured read provider host_id/epoch to original admitted member-provider identity. Every returned RetainedSectionHostObservation06 must pin these plus actual operation/request/request_digest/origin/intent/asset/tuple and exact scope/policy required by retained Read; no fabricated old HostReadContext. Callback unknown exception is provider_failed; malformed result provider_observation_invalid; original retained-read semantic Host rejection remains its genuine read result.
read.awaits: Fresh membership recheck before and after every awaited observeRead and around sink and final return, preserving first R07 failure. Recheck on both resolve/reject boundaries before selecting final cause; callback execution itself is not rollbackable. Same source profile/epoch/expiry rules remain; no provider timeout invention.
read.sink: Exactly one synchronous sink of actual ready retained result. Only strict true confirms; Promise/thenable not awaited, false/throw/missing yields delivery_unconfirmed. No retry. Caller sink can have real effects even if following checks reject: sink_invoked and sink_confirmed remain truthful. Never reclassify past external effect as none.
read.after_sink: Fresh membership check, awaited actual Host post-sink observation with full retained-read time/currentness/scope/decision/epoch binding, fresh membership check. Return true to retained-read delivery only if all hold; otherwise no delivered token. Final post-await cancelled/member check before mint/return.
read.tokens: PreparedRetainedSectionRead06 is consumed once synchronously before first Host await. It is private to this call; close and release refs on failure. The final delivered PackageRead token is private and minted only after actual ready result, sink strict true, retained-read completed delivery, current member checks and no first-cause rejection. It is a reusable historical correlation token, not a current permission lease; no new single-use handoff condition.
read.result: Read result preserves exact original retained content/full value/absence/order/refs/provenance and retained-read response-byte accounting. NativePackageSetReadResult06 is an operation wrapper, not part of Read envelope budget. preparation_failure only for actual retained-read preparation rejection, else null. delivered nonnull only on successful ready plus confirmed sink/final checks; read_result may truthfully remain ready when wrapper later rejects. registered_handles/IDs reflect actual registration before final rejection; none/registered correlates to count; host_closed true on failed operation. member_observations/reader_observations count actual calls, never projections.
read.handles: Preserve actual retained-read handle registration facts and same-Host restrictions. New PackageSet route does not expose a PackageSet expand or grant a generic reuse session. No unauthorized fresh path expansion from byte origin.
read.failure_priority: Preentry structural/brand/cancel gates precede work. Once R07 member rejection is observed it remains first cause despite later local failures. Otherwise local callback/control failure is preserved. Retained diagnostic is not rewritten to membership decision; invalid request is local invalid_read_request. No catch-all converts unknown internal error into an input defect.

handoff.meaning: Historical exact delivered-read/independently-admitted-Plan correlation, claims_not_authenticated, merged_ir/action_authorized always false at membership layer. No authentication, new current grant, run permit or execution output confirmation.
handoff.opaque: Core verify requires actual same-instance native admission, genuine AdmittedNativeConsumptionPlan06 and genuine DeliveredNativePackageRead06 paired privately to that exact admission. Read seal/admit use that same delivered brand. No publicly supplied ready result or serialized token can stand in for the private observation. Core/Read share exactly one registry through a private unexported binding.
handoff.wire: Closed NativePackageSetHandoff06 carries both origin_tuple and execution_tuple; do not equate the distinct original native/plan coordinates or relabel E. definition_digest equals this branch identity. Members all and only actual admitted snapshots, unique member_id in original compareUtf8 sorted order, HandoffMember fields exact member id, asset/version,A,C,snapshot_id.
handoff.selection_plan: Set Selection and exact retained selected set must agree after singleton normalization. Native Plan selection must equal {asset_id,asset_version,judgment_ids:[judgment_id]} exactly normalized; no multi or different judgment. Plan.source exact {asset:view.asset,origin_tuple:view.tuple,digests:view.digests,ir_digest:view.verification.ir_digest.digest}; verify original full-IR proof status, no recomputation from selected subset.
handoff.binding: Wire set_id and both tuples, host_id/epoch, delivered receipt_id and snapshot_id all equal private actual records. Read must be ready/delivered with original digests of selected whole. closure_digest=original digestCanonical(read.content.closure)=actual Plan.closure_digest, plan_digest=original digestCanonical(inspectAdmittedPlan(plan)). Every whole member and selected source must be genuine same-instance admission data. No optional silent field dropping, shallow subset comparison or claimed receipt as observed.
handoff.time_scope: verify/seal/admit handoff do not implicitly reobserve members or consume the historical token; explicit recheck(...,handoff) remains available and invokes phase read. Proof validity is not current permission. Future action still calls independent original execution Host and all its expiry/first-cause/currentness/output checks.
handoff.error: Any malformed wire, unsupported new contract/version/digest, mismatched full binding, fake/foreign opaque or Plan returns handoff_invalid without action or sink.

compatibility.versions: New module0.1.0-candidate and handoff0.3.0-candidate only. Original asset tuple/oldPackageSet0.2.1/oldexecution tuple types and old APIs unchanged. Retained-read and native-execution tuple roles explicit, no protocol meaning/permissions/resource limits changed.
compatibility.generation: The installed PackageSet schema/type/API closure is bound to its exact source and generated products. Existing types and APIs preserve their definitions. CJS/ESM share the same brand closure; strict installed type checks cover the actual public exports.
compatibility.frozen_semantics: Original data meaning, authored values, relationships/conditions/history/resources and complete native whole IR proof remain unchanged. Declaration A is a claim compared with observed A, never accepted without actual bytes. No protected credentials, network, browser or consumer implementation in this proposal.

acceptance.definition: Bind exact source and product identities, preserve existing types and the legacy subtree, resolve all new/transitive refs and values, and verify closed positive/negative shapes and TypeScript owner mapping. These checks alone do not prove runtime behavior.
runtime_future: Use distinct real two-member sources with one selected complete closure; independently compare every whole IR and digest. Keep legacy and native tuple controls separate.
Unauthorized/missing/extra/duplicate/version/invalid/member-policy/unsupported merge/selection priority, malformed provider rows and expiry equality/rollback exact cases.
Before-first-await all-byte ownership, every per-member byte authority/current signature policy, whole-only and fake/foreign brands, no asset filesystem source reads.
10000 and caller smaller counts;100MiB aggregate and percontainer25/12/8/128 exact/+1 as separately reachable inputs; no peak-memory assertion.

Read one normalized singleton, actual retained grant+Host scope/epoch and synchronous sink once, callback/thenable/abort/revoke across each await, first cause and truthful delivered effects/registered handles.
All handoff wire fields mutation, fake/foreign/serialized delivered/Plan/admission and independent native execution/output authorization controls.
Required external fixtures remain unresolved for affected selection even with other member present; no crossasset merge.
Verify actual tar members, an independent fresh offline installation, CJS/ESM, strict CTS/MTS and affected behavior. External HTTP environments require their own evidence.
